description: Company data for code and AI agents: companies, funding, investors, owners, events, public contracts and job postings. JS/TS and Python clients, a CLI, an MCP server, LangChain, Vercel AI SDK and LlamaIndex tools.
rules: Start without a key: new Alion() / Alion() uses the free open address (company, investor and job searches, lookalikes, matching, market statistics, 300 calls a day).
Pass the key as ALION_API_KEY; full profiles, slices, events, contracts and enrichment need it and are paid per row.
Set maxCredits (JS) or max_credits (Python) to cap what a script or an agent can spend.
A company is named by its domain, url, name or Alion id: getCompany({ domain: 'stripe.com' }), similarCompanies({ company: 'stripe.com' }).
Lists paginate with next_cursor; use paginate() and keep the other arguments the same.
Null or a missing field means unknown, never zero.

Agent frameworks: alionTools() from @alion-io/sdk/ai-sdk (Vercel AI SDK), alion_tools() from alion.llama_index (LlamaIndex), AlionToolkit from langchain_alion (LangChain), the MCP URL https://alion.io/mcp/open for any MCP client.
